items.fact: Never raise bare Exception; never swallow one

items.fact: Semver honestly (0.x means unstable)
Deprecate with DeprecationWarning one minor version before removal

items.fact: Hyrum's law: every observable behaviour will be depended on; keep observable surface minimal
items.where: Reading s9, s5 (linked to building_a_backend_api, which quotes it)

items.fact: Google standard: approve when the change improves the codebase, not when perfect
Perfect-is-the-enemy blocking trains people to batch huge PRs
Review priority: correctness of approach > API/interface > tests > naming/clarity > style
items.verdict: carried; Google's what-to-look-for list quoted beside it

items.fact: Style belongs to the formatter (ruff), not the reviewer
Distinguish blocking comments from preferences ('nit:')
Ask questions instead of verdicts when the author has more context
items.where: Reading s11; Review lab question comments

items.fact: Small PRs: reviewers find 90% of defects in the first few hundred lines
items.verdict: CORRECTED: SmartBear/Cisco says 200-400 LOC over 60-90 min yields 70-90% defect discovery; vendor single-company study

items.fact: Stacked PRs / one logical change per PR keeps quality flat
items.where: Reading s11 (split refactorings from behaviour changes), s10
items.verdict: carried; Google small CLs 100/1000 lines added

items.where: Reading s11 ML habits; Review lab PR 9

items.fact: Abstraction is a loan: interest (indirection, learning cost) vs principal (duplication, blast radius)
Rule of three: tolerate duplication twice, abstract on the third
items.verdict: verified via c2 wiki quotation of Refactoring 1st ed. p58 and Wikipedia (secondary; book not online); attributed to Don Roberts

items.fact: Wrong abstractions cost more than duplication (Sandi Metz); parameterised into pretzels
Declarative config over code when variation is data-shaped; DAG split; config that grows conditionals is a worse language
items.where: Reading s5 Config, plugins and reversibility

items.fact: Plugin architectures: small stable Protocol, registry or entry points, versioned hooks; vLLM/pytest/Airflow-provider pattern
